notes.title: Cats Love Boxes 1 Year Anniversary
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans! ːfofinoː

One year ago, Fofiño and Lily embarked on a journey filled with boxes, challenges, and, of course, lots of cuteness! Since then, so many of you have helped these kitties push boxes and solve puzzles that also helped you connect with real cats! ːlovecatː

We want to thank each and every one of you who played, shared, and spread love for this special game. You are part of our story and the cozy universe of [b]Cats Love Boxes[/b]!

To celebrate, tell us: what was your favorite moment in the game? Any level that made you purr with joy… or meow in frustration?

We love hearing your thoughts on our games—whether in forums, on our Discord, or through reviews! Your feedback helps us shape our experiences to be wholesome and unique. ːwinkycatː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/m10ThIP.png[/img]

Thank you for all your love and support!

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: New Game Mode!
notes.notes:
Hello, hoomans!

The [b]Cats Love Boxes[/b] update is rolling out today on Steam! ːfofino2ː

We've done our best to create a fun experience for those who aren't familiar with Sokoban. This update brings a new [i][b]Casual Mode[/b][/i] to the game with a more straightforward approach than the original mode. Purrfect for those who want a leisurely adventure with Fofiño and Lily! ːfofinoː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/McOzlEm.png[/img]

We hope this will be the push you need to get out of your box and back into [b]Cats Love Boxes[/b]! We also made some adjustments to levels in Normal Difficulty to make them more enjoyable.

We hope everyone enjoys this update! Thanks for all the love and support!

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Casual Mode is coming!
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans! ːfofinoː

We have some mews for you! Based on your wonderful feedback, we are making some difficulty changes to [b]Cats Love Boxes[/b].

[b]New Casual Mode:[/b] We’re adding an easier mode where the puzzle solutions are more straightforward. Perfect for those who want a more relaxed experience.

[b]Level Adjustments:[/b] We are fixing and rearranging some levels that we felt were weak to improve the overall gameplay experience.

This update won't add any new achievements. If you’ve already completed the game, all your achievements will remain intact. Those who choose to finish the game in the casual mode can unlock all achievements just the same, so don't feel discouraged to try our easier mode. ːwinkycatː

We intend to release this update by the end of this month. ːcathspawː

We hope these changes address some of the issues you've raised and make the game even more enjoyable. Thank you to our wonderful community for all your feedback and support! ❤️

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Sgu8Om0.jpeg[/img][i]"We'll finish the update after our nap"[/i]

Love and purrs,
The Devcats

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello, hoomans ːcathspawː

We have a small, ahem, leap in our game that might have caused a bit of a hiccup for some of our players. It seems that our beloved little Leo, in his eagerness to lend a paw, might have accidentally triggered a glitch during the latest updates. As a result, some players might have experienced their saves taking a leap of their own! ːfofinoː

The issue was related to Achievements not showing up for some players, and we've fixed it as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience this might have caused. ːsweatcatː

In the meantime, let's give a round of applause to Froglic, who's been patiently waiting for his moment in the spotlight. Is it him featured on the Google Doodle today? Guess we'll never know! Speaking of leaps, did you know that today is February 29, a leap year? We promise it's not a coincidence, just a quirky little reminder from the universe to keep us on our paws!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Kv1A0iL.png[/img]

Thank you for your understanding and patience as we work to resolve this issue. Here's the full patch notes, and we'll keep working on any bugs or inconveniences the game may be presenting, so please report them. We're a small team, and reporting really helps us hunt down those pesky issues. 

[list]
[*] Achievements Fix
[*] Bug Fix that occurred after playing one of the extra levels, where the screen would freeze at a point on the World Map (usually in World 3: Beach)
[*] Translation fix in the Gallery Info (for all languages);
[*] SFX fix during the cutscene of receiving the letter after completing Level 1;
[*] Adjustment of the "Skip button" animation for the intro/final screen;
[*] Audio synchronization adjustment during the screen transition between the World Map and the Levels;
[*] Text adjustments in various parts of the game;
[*] Added SFX when triggering the Gallery intro.
[/list]

Thank you all once more, and we hope you enjoy your time with [b]Cats Love Boxes[/b].

Love and Purrs,
The Devcats

notes.title: Play with me and my boxes!
notes.notes:
Hello, hoomans! ːwinkycatː

Here it is: [b]Cats Love Boxes[/b] is finally launching!
And we're thrilled to share it with you! ːfofinoː
It's been an incredible journey and we're purring, with our bellies up, to bring you our first Sokoban-style game! 
We always enjoy exploring new genres, so we're keeping our paws crossed that you'll love the game, so we can continue creating diverse gaming experiences for you. ːcathspawː

One of the things that makes [b]Cats Love Boxes[/b] so special is the many partnerships that brought it to life. From the captivating music to the charming cats you'll meet in the game, and the real-life cats we've been able to help; we're grateful for the chance to collaborate with fellow cat lovers like you. It's a real honour.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SZ7FtPy.png[/img]

In [b]Cats Love Boxes[/b] you'll join Fofiño and Lily on their adventure through 3 worlds and over 60 levels of box-filled fun! 
Whether you prefer to play solo or with a friend, there's plenty of excitement in store.

And we'd like to express our HUGE thanks to our [url=https://www.patreon.com/Devcats918]Patreons[/url], who are going above and beyond in helping us.
Thank you! ❤

Love and Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: This game helped me!
notes.notes:
Hello, hoomans!

As you're aware, we recently ran on our Ko-Fi ( http://ko-fi.com/devcats ) the "Your Cat in Our Game" campaign, inviting participants to donate and have their beloved cats featured in our upcoming game Cats Love Boxes. 

The little guy you see in the announcement pitcure is Joao, a rescued cat from Adote Um Ronrom -- a social entrepreneurship dedicated to helping stray cats in Brazil. Joao is one of the many cats they have rescued so far. All proceeds from the "Your Cat in Our Game" campaign were donated to Adote Um Ronrom, to help them a little. Adote Um Ronrom aims to improve the lives of homeless and abandoned cats by providing them with a second chance to find a loving and safe forever home. We at Devcats are proud to contribute to this cause and make a paw-sitive impact in the lives of these vulnerable felines fellas. Please check them out at http://www.instagram.com/adoteumronrom/ and http://www.adoteumronrom.com.br/ !

So mark your calendars for February 28th, when the game launches, and get ready to embark on a truly special adventure with your cat by your side, both in the game and in making a difference in the real world. Experience Cats Love Boxes and support a cause close to your heart. Cats from all over the world need us all. ❤

Love & Purrs,
The Devcats 🐾

P.S.: We know a lot of people could not participate in the Campaign due to limited slots. We are preparing something special for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2610090/A_Park_Full_of_Cats/]A Park Full of Cats[/url], so stay Tuna'd!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans!

After numerous catnaps missed and treats guzzled to boost our energy, we're finally releasing the game on the 28th. ːwrycatː

First off, a huge thanks to all of you for diving into the demo and sharing your invaluable feedback. Your thoughts really helped shape the final product, and we're incredibly grateful.

In "Cats Love Boxes," every stage you conquer introduces you to a cat who's just as obsessed with boxes as we are. ːwinkycatː

Our "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/41043020/view/3872596677518190106]Your Cat in Our Game[/url]" campaign participants won't just be featured in our game; all the proceeds from the campaign went straight to a cat shelter. And hey, if you're sharp enough to make it to the end of "Cats Love Boxes," they might have a surprise for you! ːfofino2ː

If you'd like to see your name in our game credits, be sure to check out our [url=https://www.patreon.com/Devcats918]Patreon[/url]. It's also a fantastic way to support us with future projects and keep our tummies full!

We also want to remind you that the tunes you'll hear in the game are by nobonoko. Check out the OST for the game dropping on his [url=https://www.youtube.com/@sinewavy/videos]Youtube channel[/url] after the game's release.

Alright, get ready to show the world that cats and boxes were made for each other! ːfofinoː

We hope you're as excited as we are for the latest Devcats adventure dropping on February 28th!

Love and Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: New plans
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/df0e4fb51833ef21830e865595720dbcad8b39c3.png[/img]
Hi, lovely humans!

Today is the most special day of all the year: International Cat Day!
"It was created in 2002 by the International Fund for Animal Welfare, to raise awareness for cats and learn about ways to help and protect them" -- and that's what we've been doing (and will continue to do) in all of our current and future games: showing you humans that cats are just as cute and loving as dogs and we cats need care, love and protection just like them. ːfofino2ː

Now to the mews!
Here are some of the news about our games:

[h1][b]A BUILDING FULL OF CATS[/b][/h1]
Trading Cards and emoticons are here! ːlovecatː
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/80d862d45067ef3071c257cd96d5cff155d67a52.png[/img]
The hint system is coming in a few days. This next update will also include a Dutch localization.

[h1][b]CATS LOVE BOXES[/b][/h1]
We had plans for releasing Cats Love Boxes this month. We really believe in this game but the wishlists are WAY bellow than our other games. ːsweatcatː
That's crazy of you, humans... It's a game about BOXES! How can someone not be excited about that? ːcrycat2ː
Because of that, we postponed Cats Love Boxes launch to the end of the year.

[h1][b]COZY ROOM[/b][/h1]
That's the game we're willing to launch next. We don't have a release date yet but we hope to launch it in September.

[h1][b]A CASTLE FULL OF CATS[/b][/h1]
A Castle Full of Cats development is going well and we believe it will be a worthy successor to A Building Full of Cats. ːwinkycatː
A demo will be available on the October edition of Next Fest, so you can play the game before buying it.

[h1][b]SUDOCATS[/b][/h1]
There is going to be a small content update later this month, which will also include 2 new languages: Japanese and Russian.

Well, that's it! Enjoy your cats and cats games today most of all days, in homage to all feline friends in the world!
Thank you again, humans! ❤️
Love & Purrs,
Devcats

notes.title: Devcats plans for 2022
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/7253cac25ab7f7a984e1aed29492149d70ca0291.png[/img]
Hi there!

It’s been 4 months since we launched our very first game as Devcats and we are very grateful for the players’ reaction.

We’ve traced plans for Devcats in 2022 and we’d like to share them with you! ;)

There’s one factor that’s really important to a game on Steam: wishlists. That’s why we’ve been revealing so many games in advance. We need to have as many wishlists as we possibly can by the day of each game launch, otherwise said game will be completely lost amidst all the other current releases.

So, we politely ask you: if you’re interested in our games, remember to add them to your wishlist and follow them, so we can stand a chance among the others. ?
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

Even if you don’t wish to buy the game right at its release, having considerable wishlists and followers helps us to gain some projection inside Steam’s algorithm. That’s right, even cats are dependable on algorithms now... :(

All of our games are being included in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25142/Devcats/]DEVCATS BUNDLE[/url] at their release – therefore you can always buy the game with an extra 20% discount if you have our previous games!

So, let’s cut to the games...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2007350/Cozy_Room/
[h1]COZY ROOM[/h1]
This is our main announcement of the day! You’ve just won a free game!! Cozy Room is a virtual room where you can enjoy the world’s most amazing companionship: Mr. Fofiño! 

Decorate your room and do whatever you need in this relaxing environment. Customize your room and unlock decor items by solving puzzles that tell the rescue story of our dear Fofiño (latin word for “cute and fluffy”). 

You can also build your own playlist, directly from your computer, with your favorite music.
Cozy Room is planned to be released in August/September.


[h1]SUDOCATS[/h1]
Despite Zodiacats being our first release, Sudocats was our very first game – we had some setbacks in the project and that’s why there were so many things done wrong. We solved all Sudocats problems in the first month and now we’re updating something strongly requested by you all: real cats pictures! Below, an example with our CEO Judy:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/c2081e2496ac2e028002e5841e04243dd694033c.png[/img]

This image is not merely illustrative: Sudocats WILL BE LAUNCHED in Nintendo Switch!

Sudocats update will be online next week.


[h1]ZODIACATS[/h1]
We’re planning to add a glossary about sign attributes (we’re doing our homework to be as precise as we can). Also, the next update might come with a surprise… ;)
Zodiacats updates are on hold for now, unfortunately. That’s because of…


[h1]STEAM NEXT FEST[/h1]
We’ll be participating with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969080/A_Building_Full_of_Cats/]A Building Full of Cats[/url]’ demo. We have just a few weeks to finish the game, which is going to be released as soon as the festival is over. As we’re just five cats, we need every paw we have here (darn it, we wish we have thumbs!!!)
We had plans to launch a demo for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961160/Cats_Love_Boxes/]Cats Love Boxes[/url] for this festival as well, but it seems we’re running out of time. We’re still working on it, anyhow. Its release is planned for July.


[h1]THE BLUE CAT[/h1]
This is currently our main project – therefore it might take way more time to be ready. It’s possible that we will release some other non-announced-games before launching The Blue Cat. Stay tunned!

That’s all folks!
Hope you liked our mews!
Love & Purrs,
DEVCATS
